visualCharacteristics.purpose: People grid with portrait, role and name
visualCharacteristics.description: Square portraits with an uppercase grey role line and a bold navy name below. 2 per row on phones (19px gutter, 20px between rows), 4 per row from 768px; every group of four people starts 80px below the previous one. Gutter 26px, 20px under the photo and 16px role text from 1024px.
visualCharacteristics.source: About us: .about-team (Board of Directors, Group Management).

contentPattern.structure: One row per person: portrait image | role paragraph + bold name paragraph

reuseGuidance: Use for team or board listings (portrait, role, name). The bold-only paragraph (or a heading) is the name; other text is the role. One portrait per person; a second image in the cell is ignored.
